title: Corn Reaper in Gas Mask
description: A hooded figure wearing a gas mask with colorful goggle lenses stands in a dark cornfield, holding several ears of corn. The ground is littered with more corn cobs while abstract colorful circles and microscopic organisms float in the foreground against a moody, dark blue and black background.
prompt: A hooded figure in a detailed gas mask with multiple colorful circular lenses stands amidst a withered cornfield at night, clutching several ears of corn while more corn lies scattered on the dark soil. The foreground contains floating transparent circles with microscopic bugs, corn kernels and biological elements, creating a surreal and ominous atmosphere with a dark blue and black color palette.
